dailyStrategy.focus: One concrete, recurring Home Assistant or home-automation question with clear search intent, useful Tara fit, and no existing TaraHome page that already answers it

compareBeforeChoosing: recurrence across independent discussions or search surfaces
a clear question a homeowner would actually search
durable or growing usefulness rather than novelty alone
a weak, outdated, fragmented, or overly technical current result set
fit with Tara's local, private, reliable smart-home point of view
a natural path to a relevant Tara guide, kit page, or configurator
preferWhenDemandIsComparable: broad recurring setup, migration, or decision questions
current product selection, compatibility, and local-control questions
common troubleshooting problems shared by many installations
practical automations for comfort, safety, energy, presence, cameras, or voice
avoid: one-off niche errors supported only by small recent threads
keyword permutations of an existing article
near-duplicate Matter, Thread, or IKEA troubleshooting pages
generic smart-home benefits content without a concrete reader question

keywordPlacement.rule: Use the reader's natural query in the title, H1, opening answer, and meta description without forcing Home Assistant when it is not part of that query.

commercialPath: Link naturally to the most relevant Tara kit page and include one restrained configurator CTA.
